decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1. The proposed two storey side extension by reason of its siting size and location, resulting from the internal layout of the accommodation, would have a bulky, dominating appearance in close proximity to the boundary of the property. This would detract from the character and appearance of the area and existing house and is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and the Residential Extension Guidelines 2003.

Condition : 2 - 2. The proposed dormer window by reason of its siting, size and appearance, on a property that occupies a prominent corner location, would have an adverse affect upon the character and appearance of the dwelling house and upon the street scene. This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 and the Residential Extension Guidelines 2003.
description: Erection of a part two storey, part single storey rear and rear roof extension to existing house
